verdicts.note: Refers to herself as a girl/woman throughout; entire gender battery addressed to her as a woman.
Explicitly 'because we do mechanical engineering' - direct match to Mechanical & Manufacturing.
Currently on her DIS placement year; placement framing pervasive throughout.
Quote only shows the D&D director knows a Loughborough lecturer, not that she attends; indirect, low confidence retained as correct.
'I personally, I like challenges' plus repeated wanting of challenging work; clear agree.
'a lot less engineering in it than I thought' supports having chosen with limited knowledge of the job; inferential but fair, medium ok.
Strongly endorses engineering as varied; prefers being an all-rounder. Maps to agree.
Course communication skills 'pale in comparison' to what work needs - course did not develop them well, disagree.
Clearly negative about uni group work (haphazard allocation, grades suffer); dissatisfied.
On placement via DIS scheme; unambiguous yes.
'an experience worth having' is retrospective valuation, not stated as her reason for wanting placement; thin for this item, downgrade to low.
'the point of coming on placement, to learn how it is in industry' directly matches seeing what industry is really like.
Wants to explore industries rather than settle - maps to using placement to help decide future direction; medium ok.
Business/managerial route, all-rounder over technician; confirms 'I think so' to managerial. Hedged but direction supports managerial.
